llm_evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T05 (TRL 6) have reasonable 2-year development windows, but T02 (TRL 5) is scheduled for completion in the same quarter it starts (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), making its TRL progression to deployment essentially zero duration — this is infeasible for a TRL 5 technology.
llm_evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio leans toward mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 5-6) rather than the lower-TRL exploratory selections expected for 기술선도; while the topics (LLM context, inference acceleration, 3D spatial generation) align with forward-looking AI research, the roadmap is not sufficiently R&D-exploratory to fully embody a technology leadership strategy.
llm_evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies fall squarely within the LLM/Foundation Model/AI Platform domain, demonstrating strong domain fit; inference acceleration and context-aware collaboration are clearly differentiated capability layers relevant to competitive AI platform positioning.
llm_evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their market boom windows — T01 misses by 1.5 years, T05 by 2.75 years, and T02 by 1.75 years; even under a 기술선도 preemption logic (targeting 1-2 years before boom), all completions are too late rather than too early, resulting in systematic post-boom delivery.
llm_evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies — LLM collaboration, inference acceleration, and 3D spatial generation — do intersect active patent filing areas and growing markets, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence that convergence zones were deliberately targeted; the selections appear domain-logical rather than convergence-optimized.

llm_evidence.trl_pathway: All four technologies start at TRL 1, yet TECH-011 and TECH-002 are scheduled to complete in 0 quarters (both start and end 2030-Q1), making maturation from TRL 1 to deployment-ready status literally instantaneous — a clear infeasibility. Even TECH-001's 2-year window (TRL 1→target) is aggressive for a high-nickel polycrystalline material requiring extensive validation.
llm_evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio correctly selects low-TRL (all TRL 1), exploratory technologies aligned with 기술선도, and the dependency chain reflects a coherent R&D-first architecture. However, the zero-duration development windows for TECH-011 and TECH-002 undermine credibility of genuine technology leadership execution, and urgency scores are inconsistently high for technologies with very low executability.
llm_evidence.competitive_awareness: All selected technologies — cathode materials, binder compositions, and electrolyte recovery — fall squarely within the declared domain of Cathode Materials/Functional Materials, demonstrating strong domain fit. The dependency chain (binder → cathode → synthesis → electrolyte) reflects awareness of the battery materials supply chain, though explicit competitor gap analysis is not visible.
llm_evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completion 1-2 years before market boom is ideal, but three of four technologies complete 1.5–2.75 years AFTER their boom windows, which is the opposite of preemptive positioning. Only TECH-007 is marginally late (1.25yr post-boom); the portfolio as a whole systematically misses its windows with a mean error of 1.88 years post-boom.
llm_evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selection of high-nickel cathodes, next-gen active material synthesis, and LiFSI electrolyte recovery reflects technologies with known patent-filing surges and growing market demand in the EV battery sector. However, the roadmap does not provide explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; alignment appears structurally reasonable but not rigorously demonstrated.
